scripts.users: cd app && bun --env-file=../.env src/index.ts user list
scripts.user: cd app && bun --env-file=../.env src/index.ts user add
scripts.passwd: cd app && bun --env-file=../.env src/index.ts user passwd
scripts.user-remove: cd app && bun --env-file=../.env src/index.ts user remove
scripts.test: bun run test:app && bun run test:scraper
scripts.test:app: cd app && bun run build:web && bun test --timeout 30000
scripts.typecheck: cd app && bun run typecheck && bun x tsc -p ../scraper/tsconfig.json && bun x tsc -p ../scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.docker:users: docker compose exec -T app wohnung user list
scripts.docker:user: docker compose exec app wohnung user add
scripts.docker:passwd: docker compose exec app wohnung user passwd
scripts.docker:user-remove: docker compose exec -T app wohnung user remove
